additions.reason: Tefillin is used throughout the Torah as a direct synonym for mochin (pure intellect). The text states repeatedly: 'תפילין מוחין' as a compound — tefillin are the 'התנוצצות המוחין' (the sparkling/radiance of the mochin). On Rosh Hashana the mochin are rectified and 'נעשין בחינת תפלין דמכסיין על מוחא'. This belongs in Package 4 (mochin cluster) as the external expression/vessel of mochin.
additions.source_quote: עַל־יְדֵי תִּקּוּן הַמֹּחִין נַעֲשִׂין בְּחִינַת תְּפִלִּין דִּמְכַסְיָן עַל מֹחָא, כִּי תְּפִלִּין הֵם הִתְנוֹצְצוּת הַמֹּחִין

additions.reason: The malach (angel) is the 'רשימה' (residue/impression) of the mochin that remains during sleep after the full mochin withdraws. The Torah states explicitly: 'אמרות טהורות הם בחינת מלאך, בחינת חלום על ידי מלאך'. The malach is built by the maginnei eretz through rectifying the mochin/tefillin. It belongs in Package 4 as the nighttime/sleep mode of the mochin cluster.
additions.source_quote: וְאֵלּוּ הַמַּאֲמָרוֹת טְהוֹרוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת מַלְאָךְ, בְּחִינַת חֲלוֹם עַל־יְדֵי מַלְאָךְ

additions.reason: Simcha (joy) is the force that strengthens the malach, which in turn protects the mochin complex during sleep. The Torah states: 'חיזוק המלאך הוא על ידי שמחה', and connects simcha to tefillin directly ('שמחה של תפלין'). The shabbat/olam haba node already in Package 4 is defined as 'שמחת ותענוג עולם הבא' — simcha is intrinsic to the mochin package. The Sukkot festival = simchat tefillin to strengthen the malach.
additions.source_quote: וְעַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ שִׂמְחָה כְּדֵי לִתֵּן חִזּוּק לְהַמַּלְאָךְ כַּנַּ"ל

additions.reason: The maginnei eretz (shields of the earth) are the true tzaddikim who subdue the evil seal (choteam destra achra = desire) and produce the mochin/tefillin. The term appears with the explicit identification: 'כי לאלוקים מגיני ארץ' and they are described as having true yirat Hashem and chashivut. In section 7 they are contrasted with the false leaders who have sword of pride. They belong in Package 2 (yirah/chashivut) as the embodiment of genuine yirat Hashem — they are the tzaddikim/haririm who shield through their genuine fear of heaven.
additions.source_quote: כִּי יֵשׁ מָגִנֵּי אֶרֶץ, שֶׁהֵם מְגִנִּים עָלֵינוּ וּמַצִּילִין אוֹתָנוּ, כִּי הֵם מַכְנִיעִין הַחוֹתָם דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא

additions.reason: The evil seal (choteam destra achra) = taavat niuf (desire for sexual immorality) is the explicit evil counterpart of tefillin (choteam dikedusha). The Torah says: 'על ידי שביית תאוות ניאוף... נעשה בחינת תפלין מוחין, שהם בחינת חותם דקדושה, בחינת... כחותם על לבך'. The evil seal belongs in Package 5 (sitra de-muta / chametz cluster) as the impure inverse of the holy mochin/tefillin seal.
additions.source_quote: הֵם מַכְנִיעִין הַחוֹתָם דְּסִטְרָא אַחֲרָא, שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה עַל־יְדֵי הַגַּאֲוָה כַּנַּ"ל, בִּבְחִינַת... הֶחְתִּים בְּשָׂרוֹ מִזּוֹבוֹ

additions.node_text: כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה שֶׁאָדָם מוֹצִיא אֶת הַקּוֹל בְּכֹחַ גָּדוֹל בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ
additions.reason: This is a note that the dataset node 'כח וגבורה, שאדם מוציא את הקול בכח גדול' and 'קול שאדם מוציא בכח בתפלתו' may refer to the same concept stated two ways (one emphasizes the force, the other the context of prayer). Both are already in Package 1. No action needed — just flagging that the proof text merges these into a single experiential reality.
additions.source_quote: וְהַגְּבוּרוֹת הֵם בְּחִינַת כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה, שֶׁאָדָם מוֹצִיא הַקּוֹל בְּכֹחַ

additions.reason: Rosh Hashana is explicitly described as 'בחינת תיקון המוחין', 'ראש דיקא, כי נעשה ונתתקן בחינת מוחין'. It is the annual tikkun of the mochin/tefillin complex. The five senses are all present in it because it is 'ראש' (head = mochin). It belongs in Package 4 as the calendrical expression of the mochin repair cycle.
additions.source_quote: רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הָאֱמוּנָה... וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה תִּקּוּן הַמֹּחִין

additions.reason: The sukkah = malach (gematria equivalence). The Torah explicitly states: 'סוכה בגימטריא מלאך, בחינת חלום על ידי מלאך, שנעשה על ידי תיקון המוחין והתפילין'. Sukkot is זמן שמחתנו = the joy that strengthens the malach. Sukkah belongs in Package 4 as part of the mochin/malach/simcha cluster.
additions.source_quote: סֻכָּה זֶה בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הַמַּלְאָךְ, כִּי סוּכָּה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא מַלְאָךְ

additions.reason: Yom Kippur is the 'גמר תיקון חותם דקדושה, שהוא בחינת תפלין' — the completion of the rectification of tefillin/mochin begun on Rosh Hashana. 'ביום הכיפורים יחתמון'. It belongs in Package 4 as the culminating sealing of the mochin-tefillin repair cycle (parallel to shabbat as the culminating state of the weekly cycle).
additions.source_quote: וּבְיוֹם כִּפּוּר, אָז הוּא גְּמַר תִּקּוּן חוֹתָם דִּקְדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלִּין

additions.reason: Shemini Atzeret = malchut = tikkun hamishpat. The Torah states: 'שמיני עצרת זה בחינת מלכות, בחינת: זה יעצור בעמי, הנאמר במלך, שזה בחינת תיקון המשפט'. It is the final stage of the Tishrei holiday cycle where the tikkun of the mochin/tefillin/malach complex is completed. Belongs in Package 4.
additions.source_quote: שְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת זֶה בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת... שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הַמִּשְׁפָּט

additions.reason: The lung (reah) is the final concept of the Torah (section 16). It is described as 'קר ולח' — cold corresponds to tikkun haemunah (via 'קר רוח איש תבונה') and moist corresponds to the lachot that rise to the brain to form mochin. The reah also produces simcha ('מאיר עיניים = שמחה') and rectifies the mishpat by cooling the hot heart. The reah is a physical bechina that encompasses the entire Torah's conceptual framework in one organ.
additions.source_quote: כְּשֶׁהָרֵאָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת נַעֲשִׂין גַּם כֵּן כָּל הַבְּחִינוֹת הַנַּ"ל, כִּי הָרֵאָה הִיא קַר וָלַח

analysis_notes.note_on_emunah: אמונה (faith/emunah) is the foundational subject of the entire Torah — it is the platform that all concepts are 'bechina of', rather than being one node among others. It is the meta-container, not a package member. The Torah opens with 'העיקר הוא האמונה' and the entire architecture flows from its fall and repair. It is correctly absent from the bechina edge dataset as it functions as the causal frame (eitza), not a shared-nature peer (bechina), of the other concepts.
analysis_notes.note_on_package_4_centrality: Package 4 (mochin/matzah) is by far the most expansive concept cluster in this Torah. The additions above (tefillin, malach, simcha, Rosh Hashana, sukkah, Yom Kippur, Shemini Atzeret, reah) all belong there. This confirms that mochin/tefillin is the positive climax-concept of Torah #5 LM2 — the entire teaching is structured as the path toward building and protecting pure intellect.
analysis_notes.note_on_mirror_completeness: The good/evil mirror structure is complete in the dataset: Package 4 (mochin/matzah) ↔ Package 5 (sitra de-muta/chametz); Package 1 (gevurot/reamin) ↔ Package 3 (yirah chitzonit); Package 6 (aspeklaria hameiri) ↔ Package 7 (koh/aspeklaria she'einah meiri). The additions (tefillin, malach) extend Package 4, and choteam destra achra extends Package 5 — the mirror holds.
